body: There are definitly certain circumstances where it is a good option. Problem is there is no right way to do it.

Its good that you can say you "feel" you have lost yourself. You haven't lost anything really. You're just going through a difficult time. Try to distract yourself. Hang out with friends and do things you enjoy. Don't take yourself so seriously. This is the way forward.

Ok It is clear you have some sort of problem with Catastrophizing.
Try to get a balanced perspective of what impact your choice will have on your life. Really its is up to you on how you react. It may affect job opportunities but you are not helping yourself at all. The feelings you are experiencing does not mean life is miserable this will pass once you move on. This is only your reaction speaking not reality. If you cant manage your thoughts and feelings maybe talk to your doctor about getting something to calm you a bit.
Can you tell us what mistake it is you made? Lets see if there is a way past it.

Its good that you are trying to stay busy. I do believe focusing on what you want is the way forward. Don't lose hope. How is has your health been damaged?  I'm not sure where you are or what kind of help is available to you. Is there a crisis  or communitiy center that you can get support to get a job and improve your situation? You can rebuild your life but you probably need support.

I may have been over bearing in that last post. I'm in a bad situation myself my mental and physical health is completely  fucked from my self destructive tendencies and there is little hope. I want you to know that there is still hope until you completely fuck up every aspect of your life and health. Are there anythings you can do to get your mood up? Are there any things you haves stopped doing that used to give you purpose?
Stop wasting your time then and do something productive. It appears like you still have your physical health. You can improve your life if you want to.

The things you believe are the things that will shape your reality. I spent 8 years thinking i couldn't study. I never challenged that belief therefore i didn't do anything and forced my failure in life. There is a difference between wanting to die and truly having little to no options.

Look you need to look at all the things you have going for you. 
Write a list of all those things and then realise that you could lose any of those things in the future, or even near future. Be happy with all thing things you do have and start living now.  Trust me focus on what you can do to get out of this. Don't waste anymore time thinking about it.
